thread:
Maya: Quick thread — need final hero and routing plan for the tri-mode launch (hosted / dedicated / private).

Liam: ready

Maya: Draft hero options: A) "Ship LLM features fast: hosted, dedicated, private." B) "Production inference that fits your SLOs and budget." C) "Pick the deployment that matches your controls and scale." Which is best for top-level?

Sofia: A is clear for broad audience, B is better for landing that targets platform teams. C reads a bit dry.

Ethan: For social copy, tease with A, then follow-up posts that emphasize B for enterprise audiences and C for security/regulatory stories.

Nora: Reminder: avoid specific latency numbers in public posts without infra OK. Use comparative language: "low-latency hosted demos" / "predictable Dedicated throughput" / "air-gapped Private installs."

Maya: Good. Webinar idea: "Serving LLMs in Production: choosing the right deployment model" — collect intent on signup form to route leads.

Liam: Proposed form field: primary_interest dropdown = [Hosted, Dedicated, Private]. Map owners accordingly.

Sofia: Mapping suggestion:
```
Hosted -> growth-sales (demo)
Dedicated -> enterprise-sales (reserved capacity)
Private -> solutions-eng (VPC/on-prem)
```

inbound-bot: Note: form field primary_interest will populate CRM property lead_interest. HubSpot workflow can assign owner based on that value.

Ethan: CTA microcopy proposals:
Hosted CTA: "Start hosted trial \u2014 free credits"
Dedicated CTA: "Talk to sales about reserved capacity"
Private CTA: "Request a private deployment consult"
Use hosted trial as default hero CTA for organic traffic; flip to Dedicated/Private for paid enterprise campaigns.

Maya: A/B test: Hero A vs B on Dedicated landing (10/90 split) for two weeks. Sofia will write LinkedIn and X copy variants.

Nora: I'll create HubSpot form + workflow today and add UTM conventions: utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch, utm_content={hosted|dedicated|private}. Ticket MARK-4123.

Liam: Dev / growth please set up lightweight A/B in Growthstack and tag analytics events: tri_mode_cta_click and tri_mode_form_submit.

Sofia: I'll drop the social drafts by EOD. Ethan will prep benchmark language without hard numbers (bench deck link to follow).

Maya: Action items: Sofia: social drafts + two hero variants. Liam: AB test setup. Nora: HubSpot form + routing. Ethan: benchmark blurbs. Reconvene Mon to review deck. :thumbsup:
